heroSubheading: We stock and service the brands locals trust for their properties and gardens.
aboutHtml:
Mark and Jo run STIHL SHOP Palmerston North. As locals who understand what the Manawatū region needs, we stock the brands you can rely on. Our range includes STIHL, Cub Cadet, Masport, LawnMaster, Hansa, Honda, and Wet & Forget. Whether you're keeping a small garden in shape or managing larger property, you'll find the right equipment and advice here.

We sell and service equipment, keep parts in stock, and give you honest advice on what will work for your job. Our workshop handles repairs and maintenance on all the brands we carry. We've supported local schools and Riders Against Cancer because this community has looked after us over the years. Come in and see what we can help you with.
